name: basic
description: A nice petal, not too strong but not too weak.

name: light
description: Weaker than most petals, but recharges very quickly.

name: rock
description: Extremely durable, but takes a bit longer to recharge.

name: square
description: This shape... it looks familiar...

name: rose
description: Its healing properties are amazing. Not so good at combat though.

name: stinger
description: It really hurts, but it's very fragile.

name: iris
description:
Very poisonous, but takes a little while to do its work.
-50% damage vs other flowers.

name: wing
description: It comes and goes.

name: missile
description: You can actually shoot this one.

name: grapes
description: It goes poof. Now with a secret ingredient: poison.

name: cactus
description: Not very strong, but somehow increases your maximum health.

name: faster
description: It's so light it makes your other petals spin faster.

name: bubble
description: Physics are for the weak.

name: pollen
description: Asthmatics beware.

name: dandelion
description:
Its interesting properties inhibits healing effects on affected units.
Affected units have their healing reduced by 20%. Stacks with itself.

name: beetle_egg
description: Something interesting might pop out of this.

name: antennae
description: Allows your flower to sense foes farther away.

name: heavy
description:
This thing is so heavy that nothing gets in the way.
Slows down petal rotation speed when equipped.

name: yin_yang
description: This mysterious petal affects the rotation of your petals in unpredictable ways.

name: web
description: It's really sticky.

name: honey
description:
Mobs love this. Attracts them in a large radius.
Mobs will prioritize this over flowers.
Affected units develop immunity to its effects after some time.

name: leaf
description: Gathers energy from the sun to heal your flower passively.

name: salt
description:
Reflects some of the damage you take back to the enemy that dealt it.
Higher rarity mobs have higher resistance to damage reflection.

name: rice
description: Spawns very quickly, but not very strong.

name: corn
description: Takes a long time to spawn, but has a lot of health.

name: sand
description: A bunch of sand particles.

name: pincer
description: Debilitates enemies temporarily, reducing their movement speed.

name: yucca
description: Heals your flower but only while in the defensive position.

name: magnet
description: Increases drop pick up range.

name: yggdrasil
description:
A dried leaf from the Yggdrasil tree.
Rumored to be able to bring the fallen back to life.

name: starfish
description: Increases health regen while below 75% health.

name: pearl
description: Just drop it off somewhere and use your kinetic powers so you don't lose it.

name: lightning
description: Strikes several nearby enemies.

name: jelly
description: No one likes touching this.

name: claw
description:
Deals extra damage if the victim is above 80% health.
-50% damage vs other flowers.

name: shell
description: Adds a temporary shield to yourself or allies.

name: cutter
description:
A friend used to own this... now it's time for revenge.
Increases body damage.

name: dahlia
description: A small amount of heal but fairly consistent.

name: uranium
description:
Periodically releases radiation.
-75% damage versus other flowers.
Effect strength depends on distance to petal.

name: sponge
description:
Spreads damage taken by the flower over a period of time.
If destroyed, deals remaining damage all at once.
Does not delay Poison damage.

name: soil
description: Increases health, but also increases flower size and decreases movement speed.

name: fangs
description: Heals based on damage dealt by this petal.

name: third_eye
description: Allows your flower to expand your petals further out.

name: peas
description: It goes poof.

name: stick
description: A mysterious stick that summons the forces of the wind.

name: clover
description:
Increases your luck.
Luck is used by specific petals to change their stats.
Luck also increases the rarity of mobs that spawn around you.

name: powder
description:
Increases movement speed.
Disabled if flower takes damage or if near a mob higher than a certain rarity.

name: air
description: It's literally nothing.

name: basil
description: Increases all healing received.

name: orange
description: A sweet citrus fruit.

name: ant_egg
description: Something interesting might pop out of this.

name: poo
description: Makes mobs less likely to want to attack you.

name: relic
description:
A strange relic. Significantly increases maximum health.
Damage taken is spread among other wearers.

name: lotus
description: Absorbs poison damage taken by the flower.

name: bulb
description: A shiny lightbulb. Draws aggro from mobs.

name: cotton
description: Absorbs damage taken by the flower.

name: carrot
description: Sturdy and reliable. Can be shot and bounces off walls.

name: bone
description: Sturdy. Loses half of its armor each hit.

name: plank
description: Does 20x damage vs projectiles and petals.

name: tomato
description: Gets stronger over time.

name: mark
description: A dark mark that binds itself to a fallen soul.

name: rubber
description: Increases knockback received. Also absorbs lightning damage dealt to the flower.

name: blood_stinger
description:
It really hurts, but it's very fragile.
Deals damage to self when spawned.

name: bur
description: Decreases armor of affected unit. Does not stack with itself.

name: root
description: Provides a layer of additional armor every interval, a layer is removed each time damage is taken.

name: ankh
description:
An ancient relic.
When destroyed, will teleport the flower back to where it was destroyed.

name: dice
description:
Has a 5% chance of dealing 35x damage.
Chance increases by 4% per point in luck.

name: talisman
description: A necklace that allows the wearer to anticipate enemy attacks.

name: battery
description: Discharges electricity whenever the flower gets hit.

name: amulet
description: Converts a percentage of overheal into shields.

name: compass
description: This crappy thing might be able to find something interesting...

name: disc
description: Reduces damage taken from collisions with mobs and flowers.

name: shovel
description: Becomes untargetable but unable to use petals for a limited time.

name: coin
description: The power of capitalism compels you!

name: chip
description: ALL IN.

name: card
description: A playing card. Likely marked.

name: moon
description:
This thing is so big your petals orbit it instead.
Where did you find this anyway?

name: privet
description: Deals extra Poison damage based on the existing Poison damage per second.

name: glass
description:
Phases through enemies.
Cannot damage enemies more often than a certain interval.

name: corruption
description: Corrupts one's soul, turning them against their own kind.

name: orb
description: Creates mana.

name: blueberries
description: It goes poof. Now with the extra secret ingredient: lightning.

name: magic_cotton
description: Absorbs damage taken by the flower.

name: magic_stinger
description: It really hurts, but it's very fragile.

name: magic_leaf
description: Gathers mana from the environment passively.

name: magic_cactus
description: Increases maximum mana capacity.

name: magic_eye
description: Consumes half the current mana and deals damage based on that value.

name: magic_missile
description: You can actually shoot this one... with magic.

name: magic_stick
description: A mysterious stick that summons the forces of the wind... with magic.

name: coral
description:
Breaks apart on impact.
Each piece has 50% of the stats of the predecessor.

name: magic_bubble
description: Physics are for the magicless.

name: nazar
description: Reduce each damage instance by 98%.

name: mimic
description: Copies the petal to the left of this, with the same rarity as this.

name: mjolnir
description: {#Petals/mjolnir/{0:rarity:is-unique}/Description}

name: mecha_missile
description: Locked on.

name: wax
description: Don't ask where it came from.

name: golden_leaf
description: A very special leaf, seems to allow you to use your other petals even more.

name: cog
description: Doesn't seem to do much...

name: monstera
description:
Heals flowers around it.
Effect fades out with distance to petal.

name: mecha_antennae
description:
Allows your flower to sense foes farther away.
And it has a blinking red light on top.

name: laser
description: Pew pew.

name: domino
description: Damage depends on how many dots it has.

name: bandage
description:
Turns the flower Undead for a limited time on death.
Delays death until expiration.
Flower Body Damage is reduced during this period.
Prevents revival for some time afterwards.

name: crown
description: Spawns Undead Beetles to fight at your side.

name: totem
description: Grants health regen for a certain duration after killing a mob.

name: triangle
description: Each copy of this petal equipped grants additional damage to it.

name: electric_web
description: It's a little less sticky, but a bit more shocking.

name: sacrifice
description:
On death, summons a mob to fight again.
Mob type depends on where the sacrifice happens.
Cannot be used in low mob rarity areas.

name: sawblade
description: This looks like it'd hurt.

name: clay
description: It sticks to dust in the air to get bigger and stronger.

name: dust
description: Sometimes it sticks together, sometimes it doesn't.

name: broccoli
description: Explodes when it hits something. For reasons unknown.

name: lentil
description: Increases petal attraction to enemies.

name: dead_leaf
description: Increases petal health but makes them reload slower.

name: splitter
description: {#Petals/splitter/Description/{0:rarity}#Petals/splitter/Description/default}
